theme.title: Mixed / Stock-Picker's Market
theme.summary: Energy (+1.43%) and Communication Svcs (+0.27%) led the market today, while Real Estate (-1.05%) and Industrials (-1.05%) brought up the rear. Performance didn't cluster cleanly by style — growth averaged -0.09%, defensives -0.54%, and value/cyclicals -0.46% — more a stock-by-stock market than a single broad theme. Major indices moved in a tighter band — S&P 500 -0.18%, Dow -0.85%, Nasdaq -0.06% — without one clearly dominating. Small caps underperformed as well, with the Russell 2000 at -0.58%, hinting the move favored large, established balance sheets over smaller, more rate-sensitive companies. The VIX fell 4.24% to 15.15, which reads as an orderly rotation rather than panic-driven selling. Gold slipped 0.81% to $4,289.80, crude oil was little changed at $78.15, and bitcoin slipped 0.16% — cross-asset moves weren't all pointing the same direction as equities.
